shortDescription: Module for setup of Image Avi RESTful Object

options.name: api_context
options.description: Avi API context that includes current session ID and CSRF Token. This allows user to perform single login and re-use the session.

options.name: api_version
options.description: Avi API version of to use for Avi API and objects.

options.name: avi_api_patch_op
options.description: Patch operation to use when using avi_api_update_method as patch.

options.name: avi_api_update_method
options.description: Default method for object update is HTTP PUT. Setting to patch will override that behavior to use HTTP PATCH.

options.name: avi_credentials
options.description: Avi Credentials dictionary which can be used in lieu of enumerating Avi Controller login details.

options.name: avi_deactivate_session_cache_as_fact
options.displayName: Avi Deactivate Session Cache As Fact
options.description: It disables avi session information to be cached as a fact.

options.name: avi_patch_path
options.description: Patch path to use when using avi_api_update_method as patch.

options.name: avi_patch_value
options.description: Patch value to use when using avi_api_update_method as patch.

options.name: cloud_info_values
options.description: This field describes the cloud info specific to the base image. Field introduced in 20.1.1. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: controller
options.description: IP address or hostname of the controller. The default value is the environment variable C(AVI_CONTROLLER).

options.name: controller_info
options.description: Controller package details. Field introduced in 20.1.7. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: controller_patch_name
options.description: Mandatory controller patch name that is applied along with this base image. Field introduced in 18.2.10, 20.1.1. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: controller_patch_ref
options.description: It references the controller-patch associated with the uber image. It is a reference to an object of type image. Field introduced in 18.2.8, 20.1.1. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: dryrun_info
options.description: Dry-run package details. Field introduced in 31.2.1. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: duration
options.description: Time taken to upload the image in seconds. Field introduced in 21.1.3. Unit is sec. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: end_time
options.description: Image upload end time. Field introduced in 21.1.3. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: events
options.description: Image events for image upload operation. Field introduced in 21.1.3. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: fips_mode_transition_applicable
options.description: Specifies whether fips mode can be enabled on this image. Field introduced in 30.1.1. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as True.

options.name: img_state
options.description: Status of the image. Field introduced in 21.1.3. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: migrations
options.description: This field describes the api migration related information. Field introduced in 20.1.7. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: name
options.description: Name of the image. Field introduced in 20.1.7. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: password
options.description: Password of Avi user in Avi controller. The default value is the environment variable C(AVI_PASSWORD).

options.name: progress
options.description: Image upload progress which holds value between 0-100. Allowed values are 0-100. Field introduced in 21.1.3. Unit is percent. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as 0.

options.name: se_info
options.description: Se package details. Field introduced in 20.1.7. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: se_patch_name
options.description: Mandatory serviceengine patch name that is applied along with this base image. Field introduced in 18.2.10, 20.1.1. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: se_patch_ref
options.description: It references the service engine patch associated with the uber image. It is a reference to an object of type image. Field introduced in 18.2.8, 20.1.1. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: start_time
options.description: Image upload start time. Field introduced in 21.1.3. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: state
options.description: The state that should be applied on the entity.

options.name: tasks_completed
options.description: Completed set of tasks for image upload. Field introduced in 21.1.3. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as 0.

options.name: tenant
options.description: Name of tenant used for all Avi API calls and context of object.

options.name: tenant_ref
options.description: Tenant that this object belongs to. It is a reference to an object of type tenant. Field introduced in 20.1.7. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: tenant_uuid
options.description: UUID of tenant used for all Avi API calls and context of object.

options.name: total_tasks
options.description: Total number of tasks for image upload. Field introduced in 21.1.3. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as 0.

options.name: type
options.description: Type of the image patch/system. Enum options - IMAGE_TYPE_PATCH, IMAGE_TYPE_SYSTEM, IMAGE_TYPE_MUST_CHECK. Field introduced in 20.1.7. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: uber_bundle
options.description: Status to check if the image is an uber bundle. Field introduced in 18.2.8, 20.1.1. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as False.

options.name: url
options.description: Avi controller URL of the object.

options.name: username
options.description: Username used for accessing Avi controller. The default value is the environment variable C(AVI_USERNAME).

options.name: uuid
options.description: Uuid of the image. Field introduced in 20.1.7. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition.
